sentences.text: Galaxy Quest is a 1999 American comedy science fiction film directed by Dean Parisot and written by David Howard and Robert Gordon .	Dean Parisot	Dean Parisot	Robert Gordon	Robert Gordon (screenwriter)	comedy science fiction film	comic science fiction
Mark Johnson and Charles Newirth produced the film for DreamWorks Pictures .	Mark Johnson	Mark Johnson (producer)	Charles Newirth	Charles Newirth	DreamWorks Pictures	DreamWorks Pictures

Parodying television series such as Star Trek and its fandom , the film stars Tim Allen , Sigourney Weaver , Alan Rickman , Tony Shalhoub , Sam Rockwell , and Daryl Mitchell as the cast of a defunct television series called Galaxy Quest , in which the crew of a spaceship embarked on intergalactic adventures .	Tim Allen	Tim Allen	Sigourney Weaver	Sigourney Weaver	Alan Rickman	Alan Rickman	Tony Shalhoub	Tony Shalhoub	Sam Rockwell	Sam Rockwell	Daryl Mitchell	Daryl Mitchell (actor)	Star Trek	Star Trek: The Original Series	fandom	fandom
Enrico Colantoni stars as the leader of an alien race who ask the actors for help , believing the show 's adventures were real .	Enrico Colantoni	Enrico Colantoni
The film 's supporting cast features Robin Sachs as an alien warlord and Patrick Breen as another alien .	Robin Sachs	Robin Sachs	Patrick Breen	Patrick Breen
Justin Long makes his feature film debut as an obsessed fan of the television show .	Justin Long	Justin Long

The film received critical praise and reached cult status through the years , becoming popular with Star Trek fans , staff , and cast members for its affectionate parody .	Star Trek	Star Trek: The Original Series	cult status	Cult following

It won the prestigious Hugo Award for Best Dramatic Presentation , the Nebula Award for Best Script , 26th Hochi Film Award for Best International Picture and was also nominated for ten Saturn Awards including Best Science Fiction Film , Best Director for Parisot , Best Actress for Weaver and Best Supporting Actor for Rickman , winning Best Actor for Allen . The film was included in Reader 's Digests list of The Top 100 + Funniest Movies of All Time .
